Given the following question and four candidate answers (A, B, C and D), choose the best answer.
Question: Some bacteria use iron found in their systems as a means to guide their movement. Which stimulus most likely triggers this movement mechanism?
A. magnetism
B. oxygen
C. light
D. heat
Respond with one of the four choices (A, B, C or D).
